jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Operations FP&A
jobs.description:
From a small family business to a multi-billion-dollar global company, Sonoco has been changing the face of products and packaging since 1899 — all while keeping the heart of “People Build Businesses” alive.

Our talented people are at the core of our growth, constantly reinventing the Sonoco wheel with brilliant solutions every year. Today we are a world leader in global packaging solutions with diversified operations in over 34 countries. We're extremely proud of our portfolio of brands, our achievements in sustainability and industrialization and the groundbreaking work accomplished by our people.

While reporting directly to the Director, FP&A Operations, as the Financial Analyst, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence through a broad range of financial and operational analyses supporting manufacturing performance, working capital management, cash flow visibility, and strategic business decisions. Additional responsibilities include plant and cost reviews, manufacturing CAPEX support, procurement and structural transformation analyses, special project assignments, and financial process improvements.

What you'll be doing:
- Prepare and review LOH and cost analyses to support plant performance, cost visibility, margin improvement, and operational decision-making
- Support plant reviews by analyzing operating results, key financial drivers, manufacturing performance trends, risks, opportunities, and follow-up actions
- Conduct financial analyses and special project work for the divisions, including preparation of pro formas, discounted cash flows, OCF analyses, ROI evaluations, and business cases related to major expansions, acquisitions, divestitures, capital investments, and business valuations
- Support the manufacturing CAPEX process, including review of project assumptions, financial projections, approval documentation, capital policy compliance, and post-completion performance tracking
- Lead or support DSI, DPO, and broader working capital reviews to identify performance trends, improvement opportunities, and actions to optimize cash conversion
- Perform procurement analyses to evaluate material costs, supplier impacts, savings opportunities, inflation trends, and financial implications of sourcing decisions
- Support structural transformation initiatives by preparing financial models, validating cost savings, tracking benefits, and assessing impacts to operating performance and cash flow
- Develop and implement approaches and templates to improve financial reporting, forecasting, planning, analytics, and management review processes
- Undertake statistical analysis and analytical/industry research to support business planning, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making
- Assist with training of new manufacturing and sales personnel in Sonoco accounting and financial systems
- Other duties as assigned

This position can be located in Hartsville, SC or Charlotte, NC.

We would like to hear from you if:
- Four Year Undergraduate Degree in Accounting, Finance or Business or equivalent
- Preferred Certifications: CPA, CMA
- Individual has strong knowledge of Sonoco's business and/or experience in other manufacturing settings
- Experience with Oracle/OPM, Onestream, and QAD
- Strong technical aptitude and ability to grasp a general knowledge of multiple disciplines and technologies
- Strong analytical and critical skills that drive a continuous improvement mindset
- Treasury/Cash Management background a plus but not required
- Manufacturing Operations background a plus but not required

Compensation:

Analyst -Financial: The annual base salary range for this role is from $67,760 to $76,230.
Analyst II - Financial: The annual base salary range for this role is from $88,000 to $99,000.
Analyst III - Financial: The annual base salary range for this role is from $107,760 to $121,230, plus annual target bonus of 7.5% of base salary.
Senior Financial Analyst: The annual base salary range for this role is from $122,320 to $137,610, plus annual target bonus of 7.5% of base salary.
This is a progression position and level will be based on candidate experience and business needs.

#LI-TW1

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst Trainee (Internship)
jobs.description:
About Sonoco
Sonoco is a global packaging leader with more than 125 years of experience delivering innovative packaging solutions to customers worldwide. Operating across both consumer and industrial markets, Sonoco combines global scale, deep industry expertise, and a strong commitment to sustainability to create value for customers and consumers alike.
With a diversified portfolio spanning consumer packaging, industrial paper solutions, and metal packaging, Sonoco is focused on operational excellence, innovation, and long-term growth. Our success is built on strong customer partnerships, continuous improvement, and the talent of our people.
Joining Sonoco means becoming part of a global organization where collaboration, accountability, and innovation are highly valued. Our teams work together to solve challenges, drive progress, and shape the future of packaging.

Position Details:
The candidate needs to be enrolled at university
Position: Trainee Treasury Analyst
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Department: Treasury EMEA/APAC
Duration: 6-month internship
Start Date: As soon as possible
Reporting to: Treasury Manager and Treasury Director (Paris)

We are seeking a motivated Treasury Analyst Trainee to join our EMEA/APAC Treasury team. The successful candidate will support the Treasury Analysts and gain hands-on experience across all key treasury activities, including cash management, treasury operations, banking relationships, compliance, and reporting.

Key Responsibilities
1. Cash & Liquidity Management
- Update, adjust, and forecast daily cash positions using multiple banking platforms.
- Upload and reconcile daily bank statements.
- Investigate and resolve cash flow discrepancies with local business units and banking partners.
- Process bank transfer requests and ensure compliance with payment security procedures.
- Create and maintain secure payment templates.
- Verify Standard Settlement Instructions (SSIs).
- Support the monitoring and optimization of cash pooling structures.

2. Treasury Market Operations & Back Office
- Monitor Foreign Exchange (FX), Interest Rate (IR), and Commodities transactions within the Treasury Management System.
- Prepare dealing tickets for FX and commodity transactions.
- Process credit advices and monitor premium fixings.
- Follow up on maturing FX transactions and coordinate with internal stakeholders regarding settlement, rollover, or maturity decisions.
- Ensure trade data accuracy and completeness in treasury systems.

3. Treasury Reporting, Netting & Controls
- Participate in the monthly intercompany netting process.
- Analyze netting data and manage related approval workflows.
- Prepare monthly treasury activity reports covering FX, commodities, and other treasury activities.
- Perform SOX controls and ensure treasury documentation is complete and properly approved.
- Monitor and report monthly interest payments.

4. Corporate Banking, Compliance & Treasury Projects
- Support bank account management activities, including account openings and closures.
- Maintain treasury banking databases and account inventories.
- Assist with KYC documentation and compliance reviews.
- Coordinate with banks and internal stakeholders to obtain required treasury documentation.
- Support treasury projects, including banking RFPs and credit facility requests.
- Assist business units with treasury-related requests and banking matters.

Who Are We Looking For?
You are an enthusiastic, proactive student looking to gain practical experience within an international treasury environment.

Requirements
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Finance or a related field.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- Results-oriented with a proactive mindset.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
- Interest in corporate treasury, banking, and financial markets.
- Experience with Treasury Management Systems (TMS), particularly Kyriba, is a plus.
- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

What We Offer
- Exposure to a global treasury organization covering EMEA and APAC.
- Hands-on experience in cash management, FX, commodities, banking, and treasury operations.
- Mentorship from experienced treasury professionals.
- Opportunity to work with leading international banks and treasury systems.
- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
- Valuable experience to launch a career in Corporate Treasury.

Join Sonoco and build the foundations of your treasury career in a truly international environment.
